title: Fisherman's Portuguese Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful fish soup originating from the coast of Portugal. This recipe combines the freshness of seafood with aromatic herbs.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the fish stock, diced tomatoes, and potatoes. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Add the cod fillets to the pot and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until cooked through.
Stir in the chopped kale and cook until wilted.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve with crusty bread, if desired.
